title: Raisin Irish Pudding Bao
description: A fusion of traditional Chinese bao and sweet Irish pudding. Soft and fluffy bao filled with creamy raisin pudding.
instructions: Preheat a steamer with boiling water.
Combine Irish pudding mix and raisin in a bowl.
Add Jgoozy and water to the bowl, mix until smooth.
Steam the pudding mixture for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil some water to steam bao dough.
Once the pudding is cooked, place it into the bao dough.
Steam the bao for another 10 minutes.
